CREATE PROCEDURE "%sNameDB%"."HX_GeneraXML_v18_TFHKA" ( DocEntry INT, Object NVARCHAR(10), Tipo NVARCHAR(100) ) LANGUAGE SQLSCRIPT AS BEGIN ------------------------- Facturas de clientes ----------------------------------------- IF ( :Object = '13' AND :Tipo = 'Encabezado')
THEN
SELECT (SELECT CASE B."Decimals" WHEN '-1' THEN (SELECT TOP 1 "QueryDec" FROM "%sNameDB%"."OADM") ELSE B."Decimals" END FROM "%sNameDB%"."OINV" A LEFT JOIN "%sNameDB%"."OCRN" B ON A."DocCur"=B."CurrCode" WHERE A."DocEntry" = :DocEntry) AS "CantidadDecimales",
'COP' AS "Moneda",
REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL((T0."DocRate"),19,0),',','.') AS "tasaDeCambio",
TO_VARCHAR((T0."DocDate"), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "fechaDeTasaDeCambio",
(T8."U_BO_PREF" || '-' || T8."U_BO_NI" ) AS "RangoNmeracion",
CASE WHEN (SELECT CASE B."Decimals" WHEN '-1' THEN (SELECT TOP 1 "QueryDec" FROM "%sNameDB%"."OADM") ELSE B."Decimals" END FROM "%sNameDB%"."OINV" A LEFT JOIN "%sNameDB%"."OCRN" B ON A."DocCur"=B."CurrCode" WHERE A."DocEntry" = :DocEntry)= '0' THEN REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL((T0."RoundDif"),19,0),',','.') WHEN (SELECT CASE B."Decimals" WHEN '-1' THEN (SELECT TOP 1 "QueryDec" FROM "%sNameDB%"."OADM") ELSE B."Decimals" END FROM "%sNameDB%"."OINV" A LEFT JOIN "%sNameDB%"."OCRN" B ON A."DocCur"=B."CurrCode" WHERE A."DocEntry" = :DocEntry)= '1' THEN REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL((T0."RoundDif"),19,1),',','.') WHEN (SELECT CASE B."Decimals" WHEN '-1' THEN (SELECT TOP 1 "QueryDec" FROM "%sNameDB%"."OADM") ELSE B."Decimals" END FROM "%sNameDB%"."OINV" A LEFT JOIN "%sNameDB%"."OCRN" B ON A."DocCur"=B."CurrCode" WHERE A."DocEntry" = :DocEntry)= '2' THEN REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL((T0."RoundDif"),19,2),',','.') WHEN (SELECT CASE B."Decimals" WHEN '-1' THEN (SELECT TOP 1 "QueryDec" FROM "%sNameDB%"."OADM") ELSE B."Decimals" END FROM "%sNameDB%"."OINV" A LEFT JOIN "%sNameDB%"."OCRN" B ON A."DocCur"=B."CurrCode" WHERE A."DocEntry" = :DocEntry)= '3' THEN REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL((T0."RoundDif"),19,3),',','.') WHEN (SELECT CASE B."Decimals" WHEN '-1' THEN (SELECT TOP 1 "QueryDec" FROM "%sNameDB%"."OADM") ELSE B."Decimals" END FROM "%sNameDB%"."OINV" A LEFT JOIN "%sNameDB%"."OCRN" B ON A."DocCur"=B."CurrCode" WHERE A."DocEntry" = :DocEntry)= '4' THEN REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL((T0."RoundDif"),19,4),',','.') WHEN (SELECT CASE B."Decimals" WHEN '-1' THEN (SELECT TOP 1 "QueryDec" FROM "%sNameDB%"."OADM") ELSE B."Decimals" END FROM "%sNameDB%"."OINV" A LEFT JOIN "%sNameDB%"."OCRN" B ON A."DocCur"=B."CurrCode" WHERE A."DocEntry" = :DocEntry)= '5' THEN REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL((T0."RoundDif"),19,5),',','.') WHEN (SELECT CASE B."Decimals" WHEN '-1' THEN (SELECT TOP 1 "QueryDec" FROM "%sNameDB%"."OADM") ELSE B."Decimals" END FROM "%sNameDB%"."OINV" A LEFT JOIN "%sNameDB%"."OCRN" B ON A."DocCur"=B."CurrCode" WHERE A."DocEntry" = :DocEntry)= '6' THEN REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL((T0."RoundDif"),19,6),',','.') ELSE '0' END AS "RedondeoAplicado",
CASE WHEN (SELECT A."Code" FROM "%sNameDB%"."@BOSERNUM" A WHERE A."U_BO_TD" = 'FVC' AND A."Code" = T0."Series") = T0."Series" AND T0."DocSubType" != 'DN' AND T0."ObjType" = '13' THEN '01' WHEN (SELECT A."Code" FROM "%sNameDB%"."@BOSERNUM" A WHERE A."U_BO_TD" = 'FVE' AND A."Code" = T0."Series") = T0."Series" AND T0."DocSubType" != 'DN' AND T0."ObjType" = '13' THEN '02' WHEN (SELECT A."Code" FROM "%sNameDB%"."@BOSERNUM" A WHERE A."U_BO_TD" = 'FCC' AND A."Code" = T0."Series") = T0."Series" AND T0."DocSubType" != 'DN' AND T0."ObjType" = '13' THEN '03' WHEN (SELECT A."Code" FROM "%sNameDB%"."@BOSERNUM" A WHERE A."Code" = T0."Series") = T0."Series" AND T0."DocSubType" != 'DN' AND T0."ObjType" = '14' THEN '91' WHEN (SELECT A."Code" FROM "%sNameDB%"."@BOSERNUM" A WHERE A."Code" = T0."Series") = T0."Series" AND T0."DocSubType" = 'DN' AND T0."ObjType" = '13' THEN '92' ELSE '0' END AS "tipoDocumento",
(SELECT TOP 1 A."U_BO_TO" FROM "%sNameDB%"."@BOEBILLINGP" A WHERE A."U_BO_Status" = 'Y') AS "tipoOperacion",
CASE WHEN T0."DiscPrcnt" = '0' AND T0."DocCur" IN ('COP','$') THEN REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL(((SELECT TOP 1 SUM(A."BaseSum") FROM "%sNameDB%"."INV4" A WHERE A."DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND A."RelateType" = 1 )),19,2),',','.') WHEN T0."DiscPrcnt" != '0' AND T0."DocCur" IN ('COP','$') THEN REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL(((SELECT TOP 1 SUM(A."BaseSum") FROM "%sNameDB%"."INV4" A WHERE A."DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND A."RelateType" = 1 )),19,2),',','.') WHEN T0."DiscPrcnt" != '0' AND T0."DocCur" IN ('COP','$') THEN REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL(((SELECT TOP 1 SUM(A."BaseSum") FROM "%sNameDB%"."INV4" A WHERE A."DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND A."RelateType" = 1 )+T0."DiscSum"),19,2),',','.') WHEN T0."DiscPrcnt" = '0' AND T0."DocCur" NOT IN ('COP','$') THEN REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL(((SELECT TOP 1 SUM(A."BaseSumSys"*B."DocRate") FROM "%sNameDB%"."INV4" A INNER JOIN OINV B ON A."DocEntry"=B."DocEntry" WHERE A."DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND A."RelateType" = 1 )+T0."DiscSum"),19,2),',','.') WHEN T0."DiscPrcnt" != '0' AND T0."DocCur" NOT IN ('COP','$') THEN REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL(((SELECT TOP 1 SUM(A."BaseSumSys"*B."DocRate") FROM "%sNameDB%"."INV4" A INNER JOIN OINV B ON A."DocEntry"=B."DocEntry" WHERE A."DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND A."RelateType" = 1 )+T0."DiscSum"),19,2),',','.') ELSE REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL(((SELECT TOP 1 SUM(A."BaseSum") FROM "%sNameDB%"."INV4" A WHERE A."DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND A."RelateType" = 1 )),19,2),',','.') END AS "totalBaseImponible",
CASE WHEN T0."DocCur" NOT IN ('COP','$') THEN REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL(((SELECT TOP 1 SUM(A."BaseSumSys"*B."DocRate") FROM "%sNameDB%"."INV4" A INNER JOIN OINV B ON A."DocEntry"=B."DocEntry" WHERE A."DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND A."RelateType" = 1)+T0."VatSumFC"),19,2),',','.') WHEN T0."DocCur" IN ('COP','$') THEN REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL(((SELECT TOP 1 SUM(A."BaseSum") FROM "%sNameDB%"."INV4" A WHERE A."DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND A."RelateType" = 1)+T0."VatSum"+(SELECT IFNULL(SUM(A."WTAmnt"),0) FROM "%sNameDB%"."INV5" A INNER JOIN "%sNameDB%"."OWHT" B ON A."WTCode"=B."WTCode" WHERE A."AbsEntry" = :DocEntry AND B."U_HBT_TipRet" = '10')),19,2),',','.') ELSE REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL((T0."BaseAmntFC"+T0."VatSumFC"),19,2),',','.') END AS "totalBrutoConImpuesto",
CASE WHEN T0."DiscPrcnt" = '0' AND T0."DocCur" IN ('COP','$') THEN REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL(((SELECT TOP 1 SUM(A."BaseSum")FROM "%sNameDB%"."INV4" A WHERE A."DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND A."RelateType" = 1)+T0."VatSum"+T0."RoundDif"+(SELECT IFNULL(SUM(A."WTAmnt"),0) FROM "%sNameDB%"."INV5" A INNER JOIN "%sNameDB%"."OWHT" B ON A."WTCode"=B."WTCode" WHERE A."AbsEntry" = :DocEntry AND B."U_HBT_TipRet" = '10')),19,2),',','.') WHEN T0."DiscPrcnt" != '0' AND T0."DocCur" IN ('COP','$') THEN REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL(((SELECT TOP 1 SUM(A."BaseSum") FROM "%sNameDB%"."INV4" A WHERE A."DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND A."RelateType" = 1)+T0."VatSum"+T0."RoundDif"+(SELECT IFNULL(SUM(A."WTAmnt"),0) FROM "%sNameDB%"."INV5" A INNER JOIN "%sNameDB%"."OWHT" B ON A."WTCode"=B."WTCode" WHERE A."AbsEntry" = :DocEntry AND B."U_HBT_TipRet" = '10')),19,2),',','.') WHEN T0."DiscPrcnt" = '0' AND T0."DocCur" NOT IN ('COP','$') THEN REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL(( (T0."BaseAmntFC"*T0."DocRate") + T0."VatSumFC" + T0."RoundDifFC"),19,2),',','.') WHEN T0."DiscPrcnt" != '0' AND T0."DocCur" NOT IN ('COP','$') THEN REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL(( (T0."BaseAmntFC"*T0."DocRate") + T0."VatSumFC" + T0."RoundDifFC" + T0."DiscSum"),19,2),',','.') (SELECT COUNT("ItemCode") FROM "%sNameDB%"."INV1" WHERE "DocEntry" = :DocEntry) AS "totalProductos",
CASE WHEN T0."DocCur" IN ('COP','$') THEN REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL(((SELECT TOP 1 SUM(A."BaseSum") FROM "%sNameDB%"."INV4" A WHERE A."DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND A."RelateType" = 1 ) - (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(T1."LineTotal"),0) FROM "%sNameDB%"."INV1" T1 WHERE "DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND T1."U_BO_TPR" = 'MC') ),19,2),',','.') WHEN T0."DocCur" NOT IN ('COP','$') THEN REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL((( SELECT TOP 1 SUM(A."BaseSumSys"*B."DocRate") FROM "%sNameDB%"."INV4" A INNER JOIN OINV B ON A."DocEntry"=B."DocEntry" WHERE A."DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND A."RelateType" = 1 )),19,2),',','.') ELSE REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL((T0."BaseAmntFC"),19,2),',','.') END AS "totalSinImpuestos",
CASE WHEN (SELECT "U_BO_Pref" FROM "%sNameDB%"."@BOEBILLINGP" WHERE "U_BO_Status"='Y') = 'Y' THEN (T8."U_BO_PREF" || RIGHT(T0."DocNum",IFNULL(T8."U_BO_CD",0)) ) ELSE CAST(T0."DocNum" AS NVARCHAR(20)) END AS "consecutivoDocumento",

--TO_VARCHAR(('20230125'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' 00:00:00' AS "fechaEmision",

T5."U_HBT_ActEco" AS "actividadEconomicaCIIU",
'0' AS "canalDeEntrega",
CASE WHEN T5."U_BO_E_mail_1" IS NULL THEN (SELECT TOP 1 A."U_BO_EmailGen" FROM "%sNameDB%"."@BOEBILLINGP" A WHERE A."U_BO_Status" = 'Y') ELSE T5."U_BO_E_mail_1" END AS "correoEntrega1",
T5."U_BO_E_mail_2" AS "correoEntrega2", T5."U_BO_E_mail_3" AS "correoEntrega3", T5."U_BO_E_mail_4" AS "correoEntrega4", T5."U_BO_E_mail_5" AS "correoEntrega5",
TO_VARCHAR(T0."DocDate", 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' 00:00:00' AS "fechaProgramada",
'1' AS "nitProveedorReceptor",

CASE WHEN T4."CityB" IS NULL THEN 'BOGOTA' ELSE T4."CityB" END AS "ciudad",
'11' AS "codigoDepartamento",
CASE WHEN T13."Name" IS NULL THEN 'CUNDINAMARCA' ELSE T13."Name" END AS "departamento",

'es' AS "lenguaje",

'' AS "codigoEstablecimiento",

CASE WHEN T5."U_BO_RF" IS NULL THEN 'R-99-PN' ELSE T5."U_BO_RF" END AS "obligaciones",

'01' AS "numeroDeReferencia",
"Comments" AS "Comentarios",

T0."ItemCode" AS "codigoProducto", T1."ItemName" AS "descripcion", '999' AS "estandarCodigo", T0."ItemCode" AS "estandarCodigoProducto",
CASE WHEN T0."DiscPrcnt" = 0 AND T3."DiscPrcnt" = 0 THEN REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL((T0."LineTotal"),19,2),',','.') WHEN T0."DiscPrcnt" = 0 AND T3."DiscPrcnt" != 0 THEN REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL(( (( T0."LineTotal" - ((( T0."LineTotal" / (SELECT SUM("LineTotal") FROM "INV1" W WHERE W."DocEntry" = :DocEntry) * 100 ) * T3."DiscSum") / 100 )) * T0."VatPrcnt" ) / 100 ),19,2),',','.') WHEN T0."DiscPrcnt" != 0 AND T3."DiscPrcnt" = 0 THEN REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL(((T0."LineTotal"*T0."VatPrcnt")/100),19,2),',','.') WHEN T0."DiscPrcnt" != 0 AND T3."DiscPrcnt" != 0 THEN REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL(((T0."LineTotal"*T0."VatPrcnt")/100),19,2),',','.') ELSE REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL((T0."LineTotal"),19,2),',','.') END AS "valorTOTALImp",
'' AS "valorTributoUnidad",
CASE WHEN T0."DiscPrcnt" = 0 AND T3."DiscPrcnt" = 0 THEN REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL(((T0."LineTotal"*T0."VatPrcnt")/100),19,2),',','.') WHEN T0."DiscPrcnt" = 0 AND T3."DiscPrcnt" != 0 THEN REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL(( (( T0."LineTotal" - ((( T0."LineTotal" / (SELECT SUM("LineTotal") FROM "INV1" W WHERE W."DocEntry" = :DocEntry) * 100 ) * T3."DiscSum") / 100 )) * T0."VatPrcnt" ) / 100 ),19,2),',','.') WHEN T0."DiscPrcnt" != 0 AND T3."DiscPrcnt" = 0 THEN REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL(((T0."LineTotal"*T0."VatPrcnt")/100),19,2),',','.') WHEN T0."DiscPrcnt" != 0 AND T3."DiscPrcnt" != 0 THEN REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL(((T0."LineTotal"*T0."VatPrcnt")/100),19,2),',','.') ELSE REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL((T0."LineTotal"),19,2),',','.') '' AS "marca",

CASE WHEN T0."U_BO_TPR" = 'MC' THEN REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL((T0."Price"),19,2),',','.') ELSE REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL((0),19,2),',','.') END AS "precioReferencia",
CASE WHEN T0."DiscPrcnt" = 0 AND T3."DiscPrcnt" = 0 THEN REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL((T0."LineTotal"+ T0."VatSum"),19,2),',','.') WHEN T0."DiscPrcnt" != 0 AND T3."DiscPrcnt" = 0 THEN REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL((T0."LineTotal"),19,2),',','.') WHEN T0."DiscPrcnt" != 0 AND T3."DiscPrcnt" != 0 THEN REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL((T0."LineTotal"),19,2),',','.') ELSE REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL((T0."LineTotal"),19,2),',','.') END AS "precioTotal",
CASE WHEN T0."DiscPrcnt" = 0 AND T3."DiscPrcnt" = 0 THEN REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL((T0."LineTotal"),19,2),',','.') WHEN T0."DiscPrcnt" = 0 AND T3."DiscPrcnt" != 0 THEN REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL(( T0."LineTotal" - ((( T0."LineTotal" / (SELECT SUM("LineTotal") FROM "INV1" W WHERE W."DocEntry" = :DocEntry) * 100 ) * T3."DiscSum") / 100 ) ),19,2),',','.') WHEN T0."DiscPrcnt" != 0 AND T3."DiscPrcnt" = 0 THEN REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL((T0."LineTotal"),19,2),',','.') WHEN T0."DiscPrcnt" != 0 AND T3."DiscPrcnt" != 0 THEN REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL((T0."LineTotal"),19,2),',','.') ELSE REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL((T0."LineTotal"),19,2),',','.') END AS "precioTotalSinImpuestos",

CASE WHEN T0."DiscPrcnt" = '0' THEN REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL((T0."LineTotal"),19,2),',','.') ELSE REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL((T0."PriceBefDi"*T0."Quantity"),19,2),',','.') END AS "Desc_montoBase",

--------------------------- Consulta Impuestos IVA ---------------------------------------

/*Cuando el descuento es negativo y tiene muestra comercial*/ SELECT '00' AS "codigo", SUM(T1."VatSum") AS "monto" FROM "%sNameDB%"."INV1" T1 WHERE "DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND T1."U_BO_TPR" = 'MC';

/*Cuando el descuento es cero y tiene muestra comercial*/ SELECT '00' AS "codigo", 'Descuento por IVA - Muestra comercial' AS "descripcion", '0' AS "indicador", SUM(T1."VatSum") AS "monto", (SELECT TOP 1 SUM(A."BaseSum") FROM "%sNameDB%"."INV4" A WHERE A."DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND A."RelateType" = 1 ) AS "montoBase", TO_DECIMAL( ( ( SUM(T1."VatSum") * 100) / (SELECT TOP 1 SUM(A."BaseSum") FROM "%sNameDB%"."INV4" A WHERE A."DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND A."RelateType" = 1 ) ),19,2) AS "porcentaje", '1' AS "secuencia"

/*Cuando el descuento es mayor a cero y no tiene muestra comercial*/ SELECT '01' AS "codigo", 'Descuento comercial' AS "descripcion", '0' AS "indicador", T1."DiscSum" AS "monto", (SELECT TOP 1 SUM(A."BaseSum") FROM "%sNameDB%"."INV4" A WHERE A."DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND A."RelateType" = 1 ) AS "montoBase", ((T1."DiscPrcnt")) AS "porcentaje", '1' AS "secuencia"

/*Cuando el descuento es mayor a cero y tiene muestra comercial*/ SELECT '01' AS "codigo", 'Descuento comercial' AS "descripcion", '0' AS "indicador", T1."DiscSum" AS "monto", (SELECT TOP 1 SUM(A."BaseSum") FROM "%sNameDB%"."INV4" A WHERE A."DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND A."RelateType" = 1 ) AS "montoBase", ((T1."DiscPrcnt")) AS "porcentaje", '1' AS "secuencia"
FROM "%sNameDB%"."OINV" T1 WHERE "DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND T1."DiscSum" > 0

SELECT '00' AS "codigo", 'Descuento por IVA - Muestra comercial' AS "descripcion", '0' AS "indicador", SUM(T1."VatSum") AS "monto", (SELECT TOP 1 SUM(A."BaseSum") FROM "%sNameDB%"."INV4" A WHERE A."DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND A."RelateType" = 1 ) AS "montoBase", TO_DECIMAL( ( ( SUM(T1."VatSum") * 100) / (SELECT TOP 1 SUM(A."BaseSum") FROM "%sNameDB%"."INV4" A WHERE A."DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND A."RelateType" = 1 ) ),19,2) AS "porcentaje", '1' AS "secuencia"

/*Cuando el descuento es negativo y no tiene muestra comercial*/ SELECT REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL((0),19,2),',','.') FROM DUMMY WHERE 1=2;
ELSEIF ( (SELECT TOP 1 T0."DiscSum" FROM "%sNameDB%"."OPCH" T0 WHERE "DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND T0."DocSubType" = 'DN') < 0 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "%sNameDB%"."PCH1" T1 WHERE "DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND T1."U_BO_TPR" = 'MC' ) > 0 ) THEN
/*Cuando el descuento es negativo y tiene muestra comercial*/ SELECT '00' AS "codigo", SUM(T1."VatSum") AS "monto" FROM "%sNameDB%"."PCH1" T1 WHERE "DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND T1."U_BO_TPR" = 'MC';
ELSEIF ( (SELECT TOP 1 T0."DiscSum" FROM "%sNameDB%"."OPCH" T0 WHERE "DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND T0."DocSubType" = 'DN') = 0 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "%sNameDB%"."PCH1" T1 WHERE "DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND T1."U_BO_TPR" = 'MC' ) = 0 ) THEN /*Cuando el descuento es cero y no tiene muestra comercial*/ SELECT REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL((0),19,2),',','.') FROM DUMMY WHERE 1=2;
ELSEIF ( (SELECT TOP 1 T0."DiscSum" FROM "%sNameDB%"."OPCH" T0 WHERE "DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND T0."DocSubType" = 'DN') = 0 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "%sNameDB%"."PCH1" T1 WHERE "DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND T1."U_BO_TPR" = 'MC' ) > 0 ) THEN
/*Cuando el descuento es cero y tiene muestra comercial*/ SELECT '00' AS "codigo", 'Descuento por IVA - Muestra comercial' AS "descripcion", '0' AS "indicador", SUM(T1."VatSum") AS "monto", (SELECT TOP 1 SUM(A."BaseSum") FROM "%sNameDB%"."INV4" A WHERE A."DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND A."RelateType" = 1 ) AS "montoBase", TO_DECIMAL( ( ( SUM(T1."VatSum") * 100) / (SELECT TOP 1 SUM(A."BaseSum") FROM "%sNameDB%"."INV4" A WHERE A."DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND A."RelateType" = 1 ) ),19,2) AS "porcentaje", '1' AS "secuencia"
FROM "%sNameDB%"."PCH1" T1 WHERE "DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND T1."U_BO_TPR" = 'MC';
ELSEIF ( (SELECT TOP 1 T0."DiscSum" FROM "OPCH" T0 WHERE "DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND T0."DocSubType" = 'DN') = 0 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "PCH1" T1 WHERE "DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND T1."U_BO_TPR" = 'MC' ) > 0 ) THEN
/*Cuando el descuento es mayor a cero y no tiene muestra comercial*/ SELECT '01' AS "codigo", 'Descuento comercial' AS "descripcion", '0' AS "indicador", T1."DiscSum" AS "monto", (SELECT TOP 1 SUM(A."BaseSum") FROM "%sNameDB%"."INV4" A WHERE A."DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND A."RelateType" = 1 ) AS "montoBase", ((T1."DiscPrcnt")) AS "porcentaje", '1' AS "secuencia"
FROM "%sNameDB%"."OPCH" T1 WHERE "DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND T1."DiscSum" > 0;
ELSEIF ( (SELECT TOP 1 T0."DiscSum" FROM "%sNameDB%"."OPCH" T0 WHERE "DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND T0."DocSubType" = 'DN') = 0 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "%sNameDB%"."PCH1" T1 WHERE "DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND T1."U_BO_TPR" = 'MC' ) > 0 ) THEN
/*Cuando el descuento es mayor a cero y tiene muestra comercial*/ SELECT '01' AS "codigo", 'Descuento comercial' AS "descripcion", '0' AS "indicador", T1."DiscSum" AS "monto", (SELECT TOP 1 SUM(A."BaseSum") FROM "%sNameDB%"."INV4" A WHERE A."DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND A."RelateType" = 1 ) AS "montoBase", ((T1."DiscPrcnt")) AS "porcentaje", '1' AS "secuencia"
FROM "%sNameDB%"."OPCH" T1 WHERE "DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND T1."DiscSum" > 0
UNION ALL
SELECT '00' AS "codigo", 'Descuento por IVA - Muestra comercial' AS "descripcion", '0' AS "indicador", SUM(T1."VatSum") AS "monto", (SELECT TOP 1 SUM(A."BaseSum") FROM "%sNameDB%"."INV4" A WHERE A."DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND A."RelateType" = 1 ) AS "montoBase", TO_DECIMAL( ( ( SUM(T1."VatSum") * 100) / (SELECT TOP 1 SUM(A."BaseSum") FROM "%sNameDB%"."INV4" A WHERE A."DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND A."RelateType" = 1 ) ),19,2) AS "porcentaje", '1' AS "secuencia"
FROM "%sNameDB%"."PCH1" T1 WHERE "DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND T1."U_BO_TPR" = 'MC';
END IF;
END IF; END

CREATE PROCEDURE "%sNameDB%"."HX_GeneraXML_v19_TFHKA" ( DocEntry INT, Object NVARCHAR(10), Tipo NVARCHAR(100) ) LANGUAGE SQLSCRIPT AS BEGIN ------------------------- Facturas de clientes ----------------------------------------- IF ( :Object = '13' AND :Tipo = 'Encabezado')

WHEN (SELECT CASE B."Decimals" WHEN '-1' THEN (SELECT TOP 1 "QueryDec" FROM "%sNameDB%"."OADM") ELSE B."Decimals" END FROM "%sNameDB%"."OINV" A LEFT JOIN "%sNameDB%"."OCRN" B ON A."DocCur"=B."CurrCode" WHERE A."DocEntry" = :DocEntry)= '1' THEN REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL((T0."RoundDif"),19,1),',','.') WHEN (SELECT CASE B."Decimals" WHEN '-1' THEN (SELECT TOP 1 "QueryDec" FROM "%sNameDB%"."OADM") ELSE B."Decimals" END FROM "%sNameDB%"."OINV" A LEFT JOIN "%sNameDB%"."OCRN" B ON A."DocCur"=B."CurrCode" WHERE A."DocEntry" = :DocEntry)= '2' THEN REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL((T0."RoundDif"),19,2),',','.') WHEN (SELECT CASE B."Decimals" WHEN '-1' THEN (SELECT TOP 1 "QueryDec" FROM "%sNameDB%"."OADM") ELSE B."Decimals" END FROM "%sNameDB%"."OINV" A LEFT JOIN "%sNameDB%"."OCRN" B ON A."DocCur"=B."CurrCode" WHERE A."DocEntry" = :DocEntry)= '3' THEN REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL((T0."RoundDif"),19,3),',','.') CASE WHEN T2."U_BO_UMDIAN" IS NULL THEN '94' ELSE T2."U_BO_UMDIAN" END AS "cantidadRealUnidadMedida",
CASE WHEN REPLACE(ROUND(TO_DECIMAL((T0."Quantity"),19,2),2),',','.') = '0.00' THEN '1.00' ELSE REPLACE(ROUND(TO_DECIMAL((T0."Quantity"),19,2),2),',','.') END AS "cantidadUnidades",
T0."ItemCode" AS "codigoProducto", T1."ItemName" AS "descripcion", '999' AS "estandarCodigo", T0."ItemCode" AS "estandarCodigoProducto",
CASE WHEN T0."Currency" IN ('COP','$') THEN REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL((T0."LineTotal"),19,2),',','.') WHEN T0."Currency" NOT IN ('COP','$') THEN REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL((T0."LineTotal"*T0."Rate"),19,2),',','.') ELSE REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL((T0."LineTotal"),19,2),',','.') END AS "baseImponibleTOTALImp",
'01' AS "codigoTOTALImp", '' AS "controlInterno",
REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL((T0."VatPrcnt"),19,2),',','.') AS "porcentajeTOTALImp",
'' AS "unidadMedida", '' AS "unidadMedidaTributo",
CASE WHEN IFNULL(T0."DiscPrcnt",0) = '0' AND T0."Currency" IN ('COP','$') THEN REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL(((T0."LineTotal"*T0."VatPrcnt")/100),19,2),',','.') WHEN IFNULL(T0."DiscPrcnt",0) = '0' AND T0."Currency" NOT IN ('COP','$') THEN REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL((( (T0."LineTotal"*T0."Rate")*T0."VatPrcnt")/100),19,2),',','.') WHEN IFNULL(T0."DiscPrcnt",0) != '0' THEN REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL((((T0."LineTotal")*T0."VatPrcnt")/100),19,2),',','.') ELSE '0' END AS "valorTOTALImp",
'' AS "valorTributoUnidad",
CASE WHEN IFNULL(T0."DiscPrcnt",0) = '0' AND T0."Currency" IN ('COP','$') THEN REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL(((T0."LineTotal"*T0."VatPrcnt")/100),19,2),',','.') WHEN IFNULL(T0."DiscPrcnt",0) = '0' AND T0."Currency" NOT IN ('COP','$') THEN REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL((( (T0."LineTotal"*T0."Rate")*T0."VatPrcnt")/100),19,2),',','.') WHEN IFNULL(T0."DiscPrcnt",0) != '0' THEN REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL((((T0."LineTotal")*T0."VatPrcnt")/100),19,2),',','.') ELSE '0' END AS "montoTotal",
'' AS "marca",
CASE WHEN T0."U_BO_TPR" = 'MC' THEN '1' ELSE '0' END AS "muestraGratis",
CASE WHEN T0."U_BO_TPR" = 'MC' THEN REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL((T0."Price"),19,2),',','.') ELSE REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL((0),19,2),',','.') END AS "precioReferencia",
CASE WHEN T0."DiscPrcnt" = '0' AND T0."U_BO_TPR" != 'MC' AND T0."Currency" IN ('COP','$') THEN REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL((T0."LineTotal" + T0."VatSum"),19,2),',','.') WHEN T0."DiscPrcnt" = '0' AND T0."U_BO_TPR" != 'MC' AND T0."Currency" NOT IN ('COP','$') THEN REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL(( (T0."LineTotal"*T0."Rate") + T0."VatSum"),19,2),',','.')
WHEN T0."DiscPrcnt" != '0' AND T0."U_BO_TPR" != 'MC' AND T0."Currency" IN ('COP','$') THEN REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL((T0."LineTotal" + T0."VatSum"),19,2),',','.') WHEN T0."DiscPrcnt" != '0' AND T0."U_BO_TPR" != 'MC' AND T0."Currency" NOT IN ('COP','$') THEN REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL(( (T0."LineTotal"*T0."Rate") + T0."VatSum"),19,2),',','.')
WHEN T0."DiscPrcnt" = '0' AND T0."U_BO_TPR" = 'MC' THEN REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL((0),19,2),',','.') WHEN T0."DiscPrcnt" != '0' AND T0."U_BO_TPR" = 'MC' THEN REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL((0),19,2),',','.') ELSE REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL(((T0."LineTotal") + T0."VatSum"),19,2),',','.') END AS "precioTotal",
CASE WHEN T0."U_BO_TPR" != 'MC' AND T0."Currency" IN ('COP','$') THEN REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL((T0."LineTotal"),19,2),',','.') WHEN T0."U_BO_TPR" != 'MC' AND T0."Currency" NOT IN ('COP','$') THEN REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL((T0."LineTotal"*T0."Rate"),19,2),',','.') WHEN T0."U_BO_TPR" = 'MC' THEN REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL((0),19,2),',','.') ELSE REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL((T0."LineTotal"),19,2),',','.') END AS "precioTotalSinImpuestos",
CASE WHEN T0."DiscPrcnt" = '0' AND T0."Currency" IN ('COP','$') THEN REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL((T0."Price"),19,2),',','.') WHEN T0."DiscPrcnt" = '0' AND T0."Currency" NOT IN ('COP','$') THEN REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL((T0."Price"*T0."Rate"),19,2),',','.') WHEN LEFT(T0."DiscPrcnt") != '-' THEN REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL((T0."Price"),19,2),',','.') ELSE REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL((T0."PriceBefDi"),19,2),',','.') END AS "precioVentaUnitario",
T0."VisOrder"+1 AS "secuencia",
CASE WHEN T2."U_BO_UMDIAN" IS NULL THEN '94' ELSE T2."U_BO_UMDIAN" END AS "unidadMedida",
CASE WHEN LEFT(T0."DiscPrcnt",1) = '-' THEN '0.00' ELSE REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL((IFNULL(T0."DiscPrcnt",0)),19,2),',','.') END AS "Desc_porcentaje",
'Descuento Comercial' AS "Desc_descripcion",
'0' AS "Desc_indicador",
CASE WHEN T0."DiscPrcnt" = '0' AND T0."Currency" IN ('COP','$') THEN REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL((IFNULL(T0."LineTotal",0)),19,2),',','.') WHEN T0."DiscPrcnt" = '0' AND T0."Currency" NOT IN ('COP','$') THEN REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL((IFNULL( (T0."LineTotal"*T0."Rate"),0)),19,2),',','.') ELSE REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL((((T0."PriceBefDi"*T0."Quantity")*IFNULL(T0."DiscPrcnt",0))/100),19,2),',','.') END AS "Desc_monto",
CASE WHEN T0."DiscPrcnt" = '0' AND T0."Currency" IN ('COP','$') THEN REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL((T0."LineTotal"),19,2),',','.') WHEN T0."DiscPrcnt" = '0' AND T0."Currency" NOT IN ('COP','$') THEN REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL(( (T0."LineTotal"*T0."Rate") ),19,2),',','.') ELSE REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL((T0."PriceBefDi"*T0."Quantity"),19,2),',','.') END AS "Desc_montoBase",
'1' AS "Desc_secuencia"
FROM "%sNameDB%"."INV1" T0 LEFT JOIN "%sNameDB%"."OITM" T1 ON T0."ItemCode"=T1."ItemCode" LEFT JOIN "%sNameDB%"."@BOUNDMED" T2 ON T1."SalUnitMsr"=T2."Code" LEFT JOIN "%sNameDB%"."OINV" T3 ON T0."DocEntry"=T3."DocEntry"
WHERE T0."DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND T3."DocSubType" = 'DN' ORDER BY T0."VisOrder" ;

/*Cuando el descuento es negativo y no tiene muestra comercial*/ SELECT REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL((0),19,2),',','.') FROM DUMMY WHERE 1=2;
ELSEIF ( (SELECT TOP 1 T0."DiscSum" FROM "%sNameDB%"."OINV" T0 WHERE "DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND T0."DocSubType" = 'DN') < 0 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "%sNameDB%"."INV1" T1 WHERE "DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND T1."U_BO_TPR" = 'MC' ) > 0 ) THEN
/*Cuando el descuento es negativo y tiene muestra comercial*/ SELECT '00' AS "codigo", SUM(T1."VatSum") AS "monto" FROM "%sNameDB%"."INV1" T1 WHERE "DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND T1."U_BO_TPR" = 'MC';
ELSEIF ( (SELECT TOP 1 T0."DiscSum" FROM "%sNameDB%"."OINV" T0 WHERE "DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND T0."DocSubType" = 'DN') = 0 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "%sNameDB%"."INV1" T1 WHERE "DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND T1."U_BO_TPR" = 'MC' ) = 0 ) THEN /*Cuando el descuento es cero y no tiene muestra comercial*/ SELECT REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL((0),19,2),',','.') FROM DUMMY WHERE 1=2;
ELSEIF ( (SELECT TOP 1 T0."DiscSum" FROM "%sNameDB%"."OINV" T0 WHERE "DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND T0."DocSubType" = 'DN') = 0 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "%sNameDB%"."INV1" T1 WHERE "DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND T1."U_BO_TPR" = 'MC' ) > 0 ) THEN
/*Cuando el descuento es cero y tiene muestra comercial*/ SELECT '00' AS "codigo", 'Descuento por IVA - Muestra comercial' AS "descripcion", '0' AS "indicador", SUM(T1."VatSum") AS "monto", (SELECT TOP 1 SUM(A."BaseSum") FROM "%sNameDB%"."INV4" A WHERE A."DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND A."RelateType" = 1 ) AS "montoBase", TO_DECIMAL( ( ( SUM(T1."VatSum") * 100) / (SELECT TOP 1 SUM(A."BaseSum") FROM "%sNameDB%"."INV4" A WHERE A."DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND A."RelateType" = 1 ) ),19,2) AS "porcentaje", '1' AS "secuencia"
FROM "%sNameDB%"."INV1" T1 WHERE "DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND T1."U_BO_TPR" = 'MC';
ELSEIF ( (SELECT TOP 1 T0."DiscSum" FROM "OINV" T0 WHERE "DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND T0."DocSubType" = 'DN') = 0 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "INV1" T1 WHERE "DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND T1."U_BO_TPR" = 'MC' ) > 0 ) THEN
/*Cuando el descuento es mayor a cero y no tiene muestra comercial*/ SELECT '01' AS "codigo", 'Descuento comercial' AS "descripcion", '0' AS "indicador", T1."DiscSum" AS "monto", (SELECT TOP 1 SUM(A."BaseSum") FROM "%sNameDB%"."INV4" A WHERE A."DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND A."RelateType" = 1 ) AS "montoBase", ((T1."DiscPrcnt")) AS "porcentaje", '1' AS "secuencia"
FROM "%sNameDB%"."OINV" T1 WHERE "DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND T1."DiscSum" > 0;
ELSEIF ( (SELECT TOP 1 T0."DiscSum" FROM "%sNameDB%"."OINV" T0 WHERE "DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND T0."DocSubType" = 'DN') = 0 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "%sNameDB%"."INV1" T1 WHERE "DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND T1."U_BO_TPR" = 'MC' ) > 0 ) THEN
/*Cuando el descuento es mayor a cero y tiene muestra comercial*/ SELECT '01' AS "codigo", 'Descuento comercial' AS "descripcion", '0' AS "indicador", T1."DiscSum" AS "monto", (SELECT TOP 1 SUM(A."BaseSum") FROM "%sNameDB%"."INV4" A WHERE A."DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND A."RelateType" = 1 ) AS "montoBase", ((T1."DiscPrcnt")) AS "porcentaje", '1' AS "secuencia"
FROM "%sNameDB%"."OINV" T1 WHERE "DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND T1."DiscSum" > 0
UNION ALL
SELECT '00' AS "codigo", 'Descuento por IVA - Muestra comercial' AS "descripcion", '0' AS "indicador", SUM(T1."VatSum") AS "monto", (SELECT TOP 1 SUM(A."BaseSum") FROM "%sNameDB%"."INV4" A WHERE A."DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND A."RelateType" = 1 ) AS "montoBase", TO_DECIMAL( ( ( SUM(T1."VatSum") * 100) / (SELECT TOP 1 SUM(A."BaseSum") FROM "%sNameDB%"."INV4" A WHERE A."DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND A."RelateType" = 1 ) ),19,2) AS "porcentaje", '1' AS "secuencia"
FROM "%sNameDB%"."INV1" T1 WHERE "DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND T1."U_BO_TPR" = 'MC';
END IF;

/*Cuando el descuento es negativo y no tiene muestra comercial*/ SELECT REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL((0),19,6),',','.') FROM DUMMY WHERE 1=2;

/*Cuando el descuento es negativo y tiene muestra comercial*/ SELECT '00' AS "codigo", SUM(T1."VatSum") AS "monto" FROM "%sNameDB%"."RIN1" T1 WHERE "DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND T1."U_BO_TPR" = 'MC';

FROM DUMMY WHERE 1=2;
ELSEIF ( (SELECT TOP 1 T0."DiscSum" FROM "%sNameDB%"."ORIN" T0 WHERE "DocEntry" = :DocEntry) = 0 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "%sNameDB%"."RIN1" T1 WHERE "DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND T1."U_BO_TPR" = 'MC' ) > 0 ) THEN
/*Cuando el descuento es cero y tiene muestra comercial*/ SELECT '00' AS "codigo", 'Descuento por IVA - Muestra comercial' AS "descripcion", '0' AS "indicador", SUM(T1."VatSum") AS "monto", (SELECT TOP 1 SUM(A."BaseSum") FROM "%sNameDB%"."INV4" A WHERE A."DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND A."RelateType" = 1 ) AS "montoBase", TO_DECIMAL( ( ( SUM(T1."VatSum") * 100) / (SELECT TOP 1 SUM(A."BaseSum") FROM "%sNameDB%"."INV4" A WHERE A."DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND A."RelateType" = 1 ) ),19,6) AS "porcentaje", '1' AS "secuencia"
FROM "%sNameDB%"."RIN1" T1 WHERE "DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND T1."U_BO_TPR" = 'MC';

/*Cuando el descuento es mayor a cero y no tiene muestra comercial*/ SELECT '01' AS "codigo", 'Descuento comercial' AS "descripcion", '0' AS "indicador", T1."DiscSum" AS "monto", (SELECT TOP 1 SUM(A."BaseSum") FROM "%sNameDB%"."INV4" A WHERE A."DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND A."RelateType" = 1 ) AS "montoBase", ((T1."DiscPrcnt")) AS "porcentaje", '1' AS "secuencia"
FROM "%sNameDB%"."ORIN" T1 WHERE "DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND T1."DiscSum" > 0;
ELSEIF ( (SELECT TOP 1 T0."DiscSum" FROM "%sNameDB%"."ORIN" T0 WHERE "DocEntry" = :DocEntry) = 0 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "%sNameDB%"."RIN1" T1 WHERE "DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND T1."U_BO_TPR" = 'MC' ) > 0 ) THEN
/*Cuando el descuento es mayor a cero y tiene muestra comercial*/ SELECT '01' AS "codigo", 'Descuento comercial' AS "descripcion", '0' AS "indicador", T1."DiscSum" AS "monto", (SELECT TOP 1 SUM(A."BaseSum") FROM "%sNameDB%"."INV4" A WHERE A."DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND A."RelateType" = 1 ) AS "montoBase", ((T1."DiscPrcnt")) AS "porcentaje", '1' AS "secuencia"
FROM "%sNameDB%"."OINV" T1 WHERE "DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND T1."DiscSum" > 0
UNION ALL
SELECT '00' AS "codigo", 'Descuento por IVA - Muestra comercial' AS "descripcion", '0' AS "indicador", SUM(T1."VatSum") AS "monto", (SELECT TOP 1 SUM(A."BaseSum") FROM "%sNameDB%"."INV4" A WHERE A."DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND A."RelateType" = 1 ) AS "montoBase", TO_DECIMAL( ( ( SUM(T1."VatSum") * 100) / (SELECT TOP 1 SUM(A."BaseSum") FROM "%sNameDB%"."RIN4" A WHERE A."DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND A."RelateType" = 1 ) ),19,6) AS "porcentaje", '1' AS "secuencia"
FROM "%sNameDB%"."RIN1" T1 WHERE "DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND T1."U_BO_TPR" = 'MC';
END IF;
END IF;
end

CREATE PROCEDURE "%sNameDB%"."HX_GeneraXML_v18_TFHKA" ( DocEntry INT, Object NVARCHAR(10), Tipo NVARCHAR(100) )
LANGUAGE SQLSCRIPT AS
BEGIN ------------------------- Facturas de clientes ----------------------------------------- IF ( :Object = '13' AND :Tipo = 'Encabezado') THEN SELECT (SELECT TOP 1 "TaxIdNum" FROM "OADM") AS "NITEmpresaEmisora", '5' AS "CantidadDecimales", T0."DocCur" AS "MonedaOriginalSAP", 'COP' AS "Moneda", REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL((T0."DocRate"),19,5),',','.') AS "tasaDeCambio", TO_VARCHAR((T0."DocDate"), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "fechaDeTasaDeCambio", (T8."U_BO_PREF" || '-' || T8."U_BO_NI") AS "RangoNmeracion",
CASE WHEN (SELECT CASE B."Decimals" WHEN '-1' THEN (SELECT TOP 1 "QueryDec" FROM "%sNameDB%"."OADM") ELSE B."Decimals" END FROM "%sNameDB%"."OINV" A LEFT JOIN "%sNameDB%"."OCRN" B ON A."DocCur"=B."CurrCode" WHERE A."DocEntry" = :DocEntry)= '0' THEN REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL((T0."RoundDif"),19,0),',','.') WHEN (SELECT CASE B."Decimals" WHEN '-1' THEN (SELECT TOP 1 "QueryDec" FROM "%sNameDB%"."OADM") ELSE B."Decimals" END FROM "%sNameDB%"."OINV" A LEFT JOIN "%sNameDB%"."OCRN" B ON A."DocCur"=B."CurrCode" WHERE A."DocEntry" = :DocEntry)= '1' THEN REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL((T0."RoundDif"),19,1),',','.') WHEN (SELECT CASE B."Decimals" WHEN '-1' THEN (SELECT TOP 1 "QueryDec" FROM "%sNameDB%"."OADM") ELSE B."Decimals" END FROM "%sNameDB%"."OINV" A LEFT JOIN "%sNameDB%"."OCRN" B ON A."DocCur"=B."CurrCode" WHERE A."DocEntry" = :DocEntry)= '2' THEN REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL((T0."RoundDif"),19,5),',','.') WHEN (SELECT CASE B."Decimals" WHEN '-1' THEN (SELECT TOP 1 "QueryDec" FROM "%sNameDB%"."OADM") ELSE B."Decimals" END FROM "%sNameDB%"."OINV" A LEFT JOIN "%sNameDB%"."OCRN" B ON A."DocCur"=B."CurrCode" WHERE A."DocEntry" = :DocEntry)= '3' THEN REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL((T0."RoundDif"),19,3),',','.') WHEN (SELECT CASE B."Decimals" WHEN '-1' THEN (SELECT TOP 1 "QueryDec" FROM "%sNameDB%"."OADM") ELSE B."Decimals" END FROM "%sNameDB%"."OINV" A LEFT JOIN "%sNameDB%"."OCRN" B ON A."DocCur"=B."CurrCode" WHERE A."DocEntry" = :DocEntry)= '4' THEN REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL((T0."RoundDif"),19,4),',','.') WHEN (SELECT CASE B."Decimals" WHEN '-1' THEN (SELECT TOP 1 "QueryDec" FROM "%sNameDB%"."OADM") ELSE B."Decimals" END FROM "%sNameDB%"."OINV" A LEFT JOIN "%sNameDB%"."OCRN" B ON A."DocCur"=B."CurrCode" WHERE A."DocEntry" = :DocEntry)= '5' THEN REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL((T0."RoundDif"),19,5),',','.') WHEN (SELECT CASE B."Decimals" WHEN '-1' THEN (SELECT TOP 1 "QueryDec" FROM "%sNameDB%"."OADM") ELSE B."Decimals" END FROM "%sNameDB%"."OINV" A LEFT JOIN "%sNameDB%"."OCRN" B ON A."DocCur"=B."CurrCode" WHERE A."DocEntry" = :DocEntry)= '6' THEN REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL((T0."RoundDif"),19,6),',','.') ELSE '0' END AS "RedondeoAplicado",
CASE WHEN (SELECT A."Code" FROM "%sNameDB%"."@BOSERNUM" A WHERE A."Code" = T0."Series" AND "U_BO_TD"='FVC') = T0."Series" AND T0."DocSubType" != 'DN' AND T0."ObjType" = '13' THEN '01' WHEN (SELECT A."Code" FROM "%sNameDB%"."@BOSERNUM" A WHERE A."Code" = T0."Series" AND "U_BO_TD"='FVE') = T0."Series" AND T0."DocSubType" != 'DN' AND T0."ObjType" = '13' THEN '02' WHEN (SELECT A."Code" FROM "%sNameDB%"."@BOSERNUM" A WHERE A."Code" = T0."Series") = T0."Series" AND T0."DocSubType" != 'DN' AND T0."ObjType" = '13' THEN '03' WHEN (SELECT A."Code" FROM "%sNameDB%"."@BOSERNUM" A WHERE A."Code" = T0."Series") = T0."Series" AND T0."DocSubType" != 'DN' AND T0."ObjType" = '14' THEN '91' WHEN (SELECT A."Code" FROM "%sNameDB%"."@BOSERNUM" A WHERE A."Code" = T0."Series") = T0."Series" AND T0."DocSubType" = 'DN' AND T0."ObjType" = '13' THEN '92' ELSE '0' END AS "tipoDocumento",
--(SELECT TOP 1 A."U_BO_TO" FROM "%sNameDB%"."@BOEBILLINGP" A WHERE A."U_BO_Status" = 'Y') AS "tipoOperacion", 10 AS "tipoOperacion",
CASE WHEN T0."DiscPrcnt" = '0' AND (T0."DocCur"='$' or T0."DocCur"='COP') THEN REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL(((SELECT TOP 1 IFNULL(SUM(A."BaseSum"),0) FROM "%sNameDB%"."INV4" A WHERE A."DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND A."RelateType" = 1 )),19,5),',','.') ELSEIF ( (SELECT TOP 1 T0."DiscSum" FROM "%sNameDB%"."ORIN" T0 WHERE "DocEntry" = :DocEntry) = 0 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "%sNameDB%"."RIN1" T1 WHERE "DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND T1."U_BO_TPR" = 'MC' ) > 0 ) THEN

/*Cuando el descuento es mayor a cero y no tiene muestra comercial*/ SELECT '01' AS "codigo", 'Descuento comercial' AS "descripcion", '0' AS "indicador", T1."DiscSum" AS "monto", (SELECT TOP 1 SUM(A."BaseSum") FROM "%sNameDB%"."INV4" A WHERE A."DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND A."RelateType" = 1 ) AS "montoBase", ((T1."DiscPrcnt")) AS "porcentaje", '1' AS "secuencia"

ELSEIF ( (SELECT TOP 1 T0."DiscSum" FROM "%sNameDB%"."ORIN" T0 WHERE "DocEntry" = :DocEntry) = 0 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "%sNameDB%"."RIN1" T1 WHERE "DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND T1."U_BO_TPR" = 'MC' ) > 0 ) THEN
/*Cuando el descuento es mayor a cero y tiene muestra comercial*/ SELECT '01' AS "codigo", 'Descuento comercial' AS "descripcion", '0' AS "indicador", T1."DiscSum" AS "monto", (SELECT TOP 1 SUM(A."BaseSum") FROM "%sNameDB%"."INV4" A WHERE A."DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND A."RelateType" = 1 ) AS "montoBase", ((T1."DiscPrcnt")) AS "porcentaje", '1' AS "secuencia"

/*Cargos Fletes*/
SELECT '01' AS "codigo", ('CARGO ' || T1."ExpnsName") AS "descripcion", '1' AS "indicador", SUM(T0."BaseSum") AS "monto", (SELECT TOP 1 SUM(A."BaseSum") FROM "%sNameDB%"."INV4" A WHERE A."DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND A."RelateType" = 1 ) AS "montoBase", TO_DECIMAL( ( ( SUM(T0."BaseSum") * 100) / (SELECT TOP 1 SUM(A."BaseSum") FROM "%sNameDB%"."INV4" A WHERE A."DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND A."RelateType" = 1 ) ),19,5) AS "porcentaje", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY T0."DocEntry" ORDER BY "DocEntry" DESC) AS "secuencia"

WHEN T0."DiscPrcnt" = 0 AND T3."DiscPrcnt" != 0 THEN REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL(( T0."LineTotal" - ((( T0."LineTotal" / (SELECT SUM("LineTotal") FROM "RPC1" W WHERE W."DocEntry" = :DocEntry) * 100 ) * T3."DiscSum") / 100 ) ),19,2),',','.') WHEN T0."DiscPrcnt" != 0 AND T3."DiscPrcnt" = 0 THEN REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL((T0."LineTotal" + T0."VatSum"),19,2),',','.') WHEN T0."DiscPrcnt" != 0 AND T3."DiscPrcnt" != 0 THEN REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL((T0."LineTotal" + T0."VatSum"),19,2),',','.') ELSE REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL((T0."LineTotal"),19,2),',','.') END AS "ValorTotalItem",
CASE WHEN T2."U_BO_UMDIAN" IS NULL THEN '94' ELSE T2."U_BO_UMDIAN" END AS "UnidadMedida",
IFNULL(T1."ItemName", 'Servicio') AS "Descripcion", TO_VARCHAR(CURRENT_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "FechaCompra", '1' AS "CodigoFormaGeneracionTransmision", 'Por operación' AS "DescripcionFormaGeneracionTransmision",
CASE WHEN SUM(T0."DiscPrcnt") = '0' THEN REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL((SUM(T0."VatSum")),19,2),',','.') ELSE REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL((SUM(T0."VatSum")),19,2),',','.') END AS "Impuesto_Valor",
'01' AS "Impuesto_Tipo", 'IVA' AS "Impuesto_Nombre", '0.00' AS "Impuesto_Redondeo",
(SELECT CASE WHEN W."TaxRate" = 0 THEN REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL((0),19,2),',','.') ELSE REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL((SUM(W."BaseSum")),19,2),',','.') END FROM "%sNameDB%"."RPC4" W WHERE W."DocEntry" = :DocEntry GROUP BY W."TaxRate") AS "Impuesto_ValorBase",
REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL((T0."VatPrcnt"),19,2),',','.') AS "Impuesto_Porcentaje",
CASE WHEN SUM(T0."DiscPrcnt") = '0' THEN REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL((SUM(T0."VatSum")),19,2),',','.') ELSE REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL((SUM(T0."VatSum")),19,2),',','.') END AS "Impuesto_Valor",
CASE WHEN T0."DiscPrcnt" = 0 AND T3."DiscPrcnt" = 0 AND T0."Currency" IN ('$', 'COP') THEN REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL(( ( round( T0."Price",5) ) ),19,2),',','.') WHEN T0."DiscPrcnt" = 0 AND T3."DiscPrcnt" = 0 AND T0."Currency" NOT IN ('$', 'COP') THEN REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL(( ( round(T0."Rate",5) * round( T0."Price",5) ) ),19,2),',','.')
WHEN T0."DiscPrcnt" = 0 AND T3."DiscPrcnt" != 0 AND T0."Currency" IN ('$', 'COP') THEN REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL(( ( T0."LineTotal" - ((( T0."LineTotal" / (SELECT SUM("LineTotal") FROM "RPC1" W WHERE W."DocEntry" = :DocEntry) * 100 ) * T3."DiscSum") / 100 )) / T0."Quantity" ),19,2),',','.') WHEN T0."DiscPrcnt" = 0 AND T3."DiscPrcnt" != 0 AND T0."Currency" NOT IN ('$', 'COP')THEN REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL(( ( T0."LineTotal" - ((( T0."LineTotal" / (SELECT SUM("LineTotal") FROM "RPC1" W WHERE W."DocEntry" = :DocEntry) * 100 ) * T3."DiscSum") / 100 )) / T0."Quantity" ),19,2),',','.')
WHEN T0."DiscPrcnt" != 0 AND T3."DiscPrcnt" = 0 AND T0."Currency" IN ('$', 'COP') THEN REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL(( ( round( T0."Price",5) ) ),19,2),',','.') WHEN T0."DiscPrcnt" != 0 AND T3."DiscPrcnt" = 0 AND T0."Currency" NOT IN ('$', 'COP') THEN REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL(( ( round(T0."Rate",5) * round( T0."Price",5) ) ),19,2),',','.')
WHEN T0."DiscPrcnt" != 0 AND T3."DiscPrcnt" != 0 AND T0."Currency" IN ('$', 'COP') THEN REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL(( ( round( T0."Price",5) ) ),19,2),',','.') WHEN T0."DiscPrcnt" != 0 AND T3."DiscPrcnt" != 0 AND T0."Currency" NOT IN ('$', 'COP') THEN REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL(( ( round(T0."Rate",5) * round( T0."Price",5) ) ),19,2),',','.')
ELSE REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL((T0."LineTotal"),19,2),',','.') END AS "CampoAdicional_PrecioUnitarioLineaUSD",
T0."VisOrder"+1 AS "CampoAdicional_ITLinea1"
FROM "%sNameDB%"."RPC1" T0 LEFT JOIN "%sNameDB%"."OITM" T1 ON T0."ItemCode"=T1."ItemCode" LEFT JOIN "%sNameDB%"."@BOUNDMED" T2 ON T1."SalUnitMsr"=T2."Code" LEFT JOIN "%sNameDB%"."ORPC" T3 ON T0."DocEntry"=T3."DocEntry"
WHERE T0."DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND T3."DocSubType" != 'DN'
GROUP BY T0."Quantity", T1."ItemCode", T0."VisOrder", T0."DiscPrcnt", T3."DiscPrcnt", T0."Currency", T0."Price", T0."Rate", T0."LineTotal", T3."DiscSum", T2."U_BO_UMDIAN", T1."ItemName", T0."VatPrcnt", T0."VatSum"
ORDER BY T0."VisOrder" ;
ELSEIF ( :Object = '19' AND :Tipo = 'MotivosNota') THEN SELECT IFNULL("U_BO_EBC",'Nota credito documento soporte') AS "DescripcionConcepto", '2' AS "ConceptoCorreccion"
FROM "%sNameDB%"."ORPC" T0 WHERE T0."DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND T0."DocSubType" != 'DN';
ELSEIF ( :Object = '19' AND :Tipo = 'SoporteAdquisicionesRelacionados') THEN SELECT TO_VARCHAR(IFNULL("DocDate",CURRENT_DATE), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "FechaEmision", '71df26dc4ebacabdcc329109efdbfc33cdf39d3e0b867620c79f51f8a337ad45999e7d4543b3b52cc4f4d4ff95eaa0bb' AS "CUDS", 'DS3119' AS"Numero" FROM "%sNameDB%"."OPCH" T0 WHERE T0."DocNum" = (SELECT TOP 1 "U_BO_AFV" FROM "%sNameDB%"."ORPC" WHERE "DocEntry" = :DocEntry ) AND T0."DocSubType" != 'DN';
END IF;
END
Queries.HX_GeneraXML_HBT_v19_FBE:
CREATE PROCEDURE "%sNameDB%"."HX_GeneraXML_v19_FBE" ( DocEntry INT, Object NVARCHAR(10), Tipo NVARCHAR(100) )
LANGUAGE SQLSCRIPT AS
BEGIN ------------------------- Facturas de clientes ----------------------------------------- IF ( :Object = '13' AND :Tipo = 'Cabecera') THEN
SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT "U_BO_Pref" FROM "%sNameDB%"."@BOEBILLINGP" WHERE "U_BO_Status"='Y' AND "U_BO_Status" = 'Y') = 'Y' THEN (T8."U_BO_PREF"||T0."DocNum") ELSE CAST(T0."DocNum" AS NVARCHAR(20)) END AS "Numero",
TO_VARCHAR('20241017', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "FechaEmision", TO_VARCHAR(T0."DocDueDate", 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "Vencimiento",
CASE WHEN LENGTH(T0."DocTime") = '3' THEN ' 0' || ( SUBSTRING (CAST(T0."DocTime" AS VARCHAR(6)),1,1) || ':' || SUBSTRING (CAST(T0."DocTime" AS VARCHAR(6)),2,3) ) || ':00' ELSE ( SUBSTRING (CAST(T0."DocTime" AS VARCHAR(6)),1,2) || ':' || SUBSTRING (CAST(T0."DocTime" AS VARCHAR(6)),3,4)) || ':00' END AS "HoraEmision",
'COP' AS "MonedaFactura", T0."Comments" AS "Observaciones",
CASE WHEN (SELECT A."Code" FROM "%sNameDB%"."@BOSERNUM" A WHERE A."Code" = T0."Series" AND "U_BO_TD"='FVC') = T0."Series" AND T0."DocSubType" != 'DN' AND T0."ObjType" = '13' THEN '01' WHEN (SELECT A."Code" FROM "%sNameDB%"."@BOSERNUM" A WHERE A."Code" = T0."Series" AND "U_BO_TD"='FVE') = T0."Series" AND T0."DocSubType" != 'DN' AND T0."ObjType" = '13' THEN '02' WHEN (SELECT A."Code" FROM "%sNameDB%"."@BOSERNUM" A WHERE A."Code" = T0."Series") = T0."Series" AND T0."DocSubType" != 'DN' AND T0."ObjType" = '13' THEN '03' WHEN (SELECT A."Code" FROM "%sNameDB%"."@BOSERNUM" A WHERE A."Code" = T0."Series") = T0."Series" AND T0."DocSubType" != 'DN' AND T0."ObjType" = '14' THEN '91' WHEN (SELECT A."Code" FROM "%sNameDB%"."@BOSERNUM" A WHERE A."Code" = T0."Series") = T0."Series" AND T0."DocSubType" = 'DN' AND T0."ObjType" = '13' THEN '92' ELSE '0' END AS "TipoFactura",
CASE WHEN T11."ExtraDays" > '0' THEN '2' ELSE '1' END AS "FormaDePago",
(SELECT COUNT("ItemCode") FROM "%sNameDB%"."INV1" WHERE "DocEntry" = :DocEntry) AS "LineasDeFactura",
10 AS "TipoOperacion", NULL AS "SubTipoOperacion", NULL AS "FormatoContingencia", T0."NumAtCard" AS "OrdenCompra", NULL AS "FechaOrdenCompra",
CASE WHEN (SELECT "U_BO_Mdo" FROM "%sNameDB%"."@BOEBILLINGP" WHERE "U_BO_Status" = 'Y') = 'PRO' THEN '1' ELSE '2' END AS "Ambiente",
'Factura' AS "TipoTransaccionFBE"
FROM "%sNameDB%"."OINV" T0 LEFT JOIN "%sNameDB%"."INV12" T4 ON T0."DocEntry"=T4."DocEntry" LEFT JOIN "%sNameDB%"."OCRD" T5 ON T0."CardCode" = T5."CardCode" and T5."CardType" != 'S' LEFT JOIN "%sNameDB%"."NNM1" T6 ON T0."Series"=T6."Series" AND T6."ObjectCode" = '13' LEFT OUTER JOIN "%sNameDB%"."OSLP" T7 ON T0."SlpCode" = T7."SlpCode" LEFT JOIN "%sNameDB%"."@BOSERNUM" T8 ON T0."Series"=T8."Code" LEFT JOIN "%sNameDB%"."OCTG" T11 ON T0."GroupNum"=T11."GroupNum" LEFT JOIN "%sNameDB%"."OSHP" T12 ON T0."TrnspCode" = T12."TrnspCode" LEFT JOIN "%sNameDB%"."OCST" T13 ON T4."StateB" = T13."Code" AND T13."Country" ='CO' --LEFT JOIN "%sNameDB%"."@HCO_RP1101" H2 on H2."U_CardCode" = T0."CardCode" and T5."CardType" != 'S' --LEFT JOIN "%sNameDB%"."@HCO_RP1100" H1 on H1."Code" = H2."Code" LEFT JOIN "%sNameDB%"."OSLP" T14 on T0."SlpCode" = T14."SlpCode"
WHERE T0."DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND T0."DocSubType" != 'DN';
ELSEIF ( :Object = '13' AND :Tipo = 'ObservacionesAdicionales') THEN
SELECT '' AS "Observaciones1" FROM "OINV" WHERE 1=2;
ELSEIF ( :Object = '13' AND :Tipo = 'NumeracionDIAN') THEN
SELECT T8."U_BO_NR" AS "NumeroResolucion", TO_VARCHAR((T8."U_BO_FR"), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "FechaInicio", TO_VARCHAR((T8."U_BO_FF"), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "FechaFin", T8."U_BO_PREF" AS "PrefijoNumeracion", T8."U_BO_NI" AS "ConsecutivoInicial", T8."U_BO_NF" AS "ConsecutivoFinal"
FROM "%sNameDB%"."OINV" T0 LEFT JOIN "%sNameDB%"."NNM1" T6 ON T0."Series"=T6."Series" AND T6."ObjectCode" = '13' LEFT JOIN "%sNameDB%"."@BOSERNUM" T8 ON T0."Series"=T8."Code" WHERE T0."DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND T0."DocSubType" != 'DN';
ELSEIF ( :Object = '13' AND :Tipo = 'Notificacion') THEN
SELECT CASE WHEN T1."U_BO_E_mail_1" IS NULL THEN (SELECT TOP 1 LOWER(A."U_BO_EmailGen") FROM "%sNameDB%"."@BOEBILLINGP" A WHERE A."U_BO_Status" = 'Y') ELSE LOWER(T1."U_BO_E_mail_1") END AS "correoEntrega1", LOWER(T1."U_BO_E_mail_2") AS "correoEntrega2", LOWER(T1."U_BO_E_mail_3") AS "correoEntrega3", LOWER(T1."U_BO_E_mail_4") AS "correoEntrega4", LOWER(T1."U_BO_E_mail_5") AS "correoEntrega5", 'Mail' AS "Tipo", '' AS "De"
FROM "%sNameDB%"."OINV" T0 LEFT JOIN "%sNameDB%"."OCRD" T1 ON T0."CardCode"=T1."CardCode" WHERE T0."DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND T0."DocSubType" != 'DN';
ELSEIF ( :Object = '13' AND :Tipo = 'Emisor') THEN SELECT "U_HBT_TipEnt" AS "TipoPersona", "CompnyName" AS "RazonSocial", "U_HBT_RegFis" AS "TipoRegimen", '31' AS "TipoIdentificacion",
CASE WHEN LOCATE("TaxIdNum",'-') > 0 THEN SUBSTRING("TaxIdNum",1,LOCATE("TaxIdNum",'-')-1) ELSE "TaxIdNum" END AS "NumeroIdentificacion",
RIGHT("TaxIdNum",1) AS "DV"
FROM "%sNameDB%"."OADM";
ELSEIF ( :Object = '13' AND :Tipo = 'Emisor_Obligaciones') THEN SELECT "U_HBT_ResFis" AS "CodigoObligacion" FROM "%sNameDB%"."OADM";
ELSEIF ( :Object = '13' AND :Tipo = 'Emisor_Tributo') THEN SELECT "U_HBT_InfoTrib" AS "CodigoTributo", CASE WHEN "U_HBT_InfoTrib" = '01' THEN 'IVA' WHEN "U_HBT_InfoTrib" = '04' THEN 'INC' WHEN "U_HBT_InfoTrib" = 'ZA' THEN 'IVA e INC' WHEN "U_HBT_InfoTrib" = 'ZZ' THEN 'No aplica *' ELSE '' END AS "NombreTributo"
--( SELECT "Descr" FROM "UFD1"WHERE "TableID" = 'OADM' AND "FieldID" = (SELECT "FieldID" FROM "CUFD" WHERE "AliasID" = 'HX_CodTrib' AND "TableID" = 'OADM') AND "FldValue" = (SELECT "U_HX_CodTrib" FROM "OADM")) FROM "%sNameDB%"."OADM";
ELSEIF ( :Object = '13' AND :Tipo = 'Emisor_direccion') THEN
SELECT "Country" AS "CodigoPais", (SELECT "Name" FROM "OCRY" WHERE "Code" = "Country" ) AS "NombrePais", 'es' AS "IdiomaPais", "U_HBT_MunMed" AS "CodigoMunicipio", (SELECT "Name" FROM "@HBT_MUNICIPIO" WHERE "Code" = "U_HBT_MunMed" ) AS "NombreCiudad", (SELECT "ZipCode" FROM "%sNameDB%"."ADM1") AS "CodigoPostal", SUBSTRING("U_HBT_MunMed",0,2) AS "CodigoDepartamento", '' AS "NombreDepartamento", ((SELECT "Street" FROM "%sNameDB%"."ADM1")) AS "Direccion"
FROM "%sNameDB%"."OADM";
ELSEIF ( :Object = '13' AND :Tipo = 'Cliente') THEN SELECT CASE T5."U_HBT_TipEnt" WHEN '1' THEN '1' WHEN '2' THEN '2' ELSE T5."U_HBT_TipEnt" END AS "TipoPersona",
CASE WHEN T5."U_BO_TR" = '01' THEN '48' WHEN T5."U_BO_TR" = '04' THEN '48' WHEN T5."U_BO_TR" = 'ZA' THEN '48' WHEN T5."U_BO_TR" = 'ZZ' THEN '49' ELSE T5."U_BO_TR" END AS "TipoRegimen",
T5."U_HBT_TipDoc" AS "TipoIdentificacion",
CASE WHEN LOCATE(T5."LicTradNum",'-') > 0 THEN SUBSTRING(T5."LicTradNum",1,LOCATE(T5."LicTradNum",'-')-1) ELSE T5."LicTradNum" END AS "NumeroIdentificacion",
CASE T5."U_HBT_TipDoc" WHEN '31' THEN RIGHT(T5."LicTradNum",1) ELSE '' END AS "DV",
T5."CardName" AS "RazonSocial",
T5."CardName" AS "NombreComercial"
FROM "%sNameDB%"."OINV" T0 LEFT JOIN "%sNameDB%"."OCRD" T5 ON T0."CardCode" = T5."CardCode" LEFT OUTER JOIN "%sNameDB%"."OSLP" T7 ON T0."SlpCode" = T7."SlpCode" LEFT JOIN "%sNameDB%"."@BOSERNUM" T8 ON T0."Series"=T8."Code" --lEFT JOIN "%sNameDB%"."@HCO_RP1101" H2 on H2."U_CardCode" = T0."CardCode" --LEFT JOIN "%sNameDB%"."@HCO_RP1100" H1 on H1."Code" = H2."Code" --LEFT JOIN "%sNameDB%"."@HCO_RP0004" H5 on H1."U_DeptCode" = H5."Code" --LEFT JOIN "%sNameDB%"."@HCO_RP0005" H6 on H1."U_CountyCode" = H6."Code"
WHERE T0."DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND T0."DocSubType" != 'ND';
ELSEIF ( :Object = '13' AND :Tipo = 'Cliente_direccion') THEN SELECT T15."Country" AS "CodigoPais", (SELECT "Name" FROM "OCRY" WHERE "Code" = T15."Country" ) AS "NombrePais", 'es' AS "IdiomaPais", T5."U_HBT_MunMed" AS "CodigoMunicipio", (SELECT "Name" FROM "@HBT_MUNICIPIO" WHERE "Code" = T5."U_HBT_MunMed" ) AS "NombreCiudad", T5."ZipCode" AS "CodigoPostal", '' AS "NombreDepartamento", SUBSTRING(T5."U_HBT_MunMed",1,2) AS "CodigoDepartamento", T4."StreetB" AS "Direccion"
FROM "%sNameDB%"."OINV" T0 LEFT JOIN "%sNameDB%"."INV12" T4 ON T0."DocEntry"=T4."DocEntry" LEFT JOIN "%sNameDB%"."OCRD" T5 ON T0."CardCode" = T5."CardCode" LEFT JOIN "%sNameDB%"."CRD1" T15 ON T0."CardCode"=T15."CardCode" AND T15."AdresType" = 'B'
WHERE T0."DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND T0."DocSubType" != 'ND';
ELSEIF ( :Object = '13' AND :Tipo = 'Cliente_ObligacionesCliente') THEN SELECT T5."U_BO_RF" AS "CodigoObligacion"
FROM "%sNameDB%"."OINV" T0 LEFT JOIN "%sNameDB%"."OCRD" T5 ON T0."CardCode" = T5."CardCode"
WHERE T0."DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND T0."DocSubType" != 'ND';
ELSEIF ( :Object = '13' AND :Tipo = 'Cliente_DireccionFiscal') THEN SELECT T15."Country" AS "CodigoPais", (SELECT "Name" FROM "OCRY" WHERE "Code" = T15."Country" ) AS "NombrePais", 'es' AS "IdiomaPais", T5."U_HBT_MunMed" AS "CodigoMunicipio", (SELECT "Name" FROM "@HBT_MUNICIPIO" WHERE "Code" = T5."U_HBT_MunMed" ) AS "NombreCiudad", T5."ZipCode" AS "CodigoPostal", '' AS "NombreDepartamento", SUBSTRING(T5."U_HBT_MunMed",1,2) AS "CodigoDepartamento", T4."StreetB" AS "Direccion"
FROM "%sNameDB%"."OINV" T0 LEFT JOIN "%sNameDB%"."INV12" T4 ON T0."DocEntry"=T4."DocEntry" LEFT JOIN "%sNameDB%"."OCRD" T5 ON T0."CardCode" = T5."CardCode" LEFT JOIN "%sNameDB%"."CRD1" T15 ON T0."CardCode"=T15."CardCode" AND T15."AdresType" = 'B'
WHERE T0."DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND T0."DocSubType" != 'ND';
ELSEIF ( :Object = '13' AND :Tipo = 'Cliente_TributoCliente') THEN SELECT T5."U_BO_TR" AS "CodigoTributo",
CASE WHEN "U_BO_TR" = '01' THEN 'IVA' WHEN "U_BO_TR" = '04' THEN 'INC' WHEN "U_BO_TR" = 'ZA' THEN 'IVA e INC' WHEN "U_BO_TR" = 'ZZ' THEN 'No aplica *' ELSE '' END AS "NombreTributo"
FROM "%sNameDB%"."OINV" T0 LEFT JOIN "%sNameDB%"."INV12" T4 ON T0."DocEntry"=T4."DocEntry" LEFT JOIN "%sNameDB%"."OCRD" T5 ON T0."CardCode" = T5."CardCode" --LEFT JOIN "%sNameDB%"."@HCO_RP1101" H2 on H2."U_CardCode" = T0."CardCode" --LEFT JOIN "%sNameDB%"."@HCO_RP1100" H1 on H1."Code" = H2."Code" --LEFT JOIN "%sNameDB%"."@HCO_RP0004" H5 on H1."U_DeptCode" = H5."Code" --LEFT JOIN "%sNameDB%"."@HCO_RP0005" H6 on H1."U_CountyCode" = H6."Code" LEFT JOIN "%sNameDB%"."CRD1" T15 ON T0."CardCode"=T15."CardCode" AND T15."AdresType" = 'B'
WHERE T0."DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND T0."DocSubType" != 'ND';
ELSEIF ( :Object = '13' AND :Tipo = 'MediosDePago') THEN SELECT CASE WHEN T0."U_BO_MP" IS NULL THEN (SELECT "U_BO_MPE" FROM "@BOEBILLINGP" WHERE "U_BO_Status" = 'Y') ELSE T0."U_BO_MP" END AS "CodigoMedioPago"
FROM "%sNameDB%"."OINV" T0
WHERE T0."DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND T0."DocSubType" != 'ND';
ELSEIF ( :Object = '13' AND :Tipo = 'Anticipos') THEN SELECT '1' AS "Anticipo" FROM DUMMY WHERE 1=2;
ELSEIF ( :Object = '13' AND :Tipo = 'DescuentosoCargos') THEN SELECT '1' AS "DescuentosoCargos" FROM DUMMY WHERE 1=2;
ELSEIF ( :Object = '13' AND :Tipo = 'TasaDeCambio') THEN SELECT 'COP' AS "MonedaDestino", REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL((T0."DocRate"),19,2),',','.') AS "ValorTasaDeCambio", T0."DocDate" as "FechaTasaDeCambio"
FROM "%sNameDB%"."OINV" T0
WHERE T0."DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND T0."DocSubType" != 'ND';
ELSEIF ( :Object = '13' AND :Tipo = 'TasaDeCambioAlterna') THEN SELECT 'COP' AS "MonedaDestino", REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL((T0."DocRate"),19,2),',','.') AS "ValorTasaDeCambio", T0."DocDate" as "FechaTasaDeCambio"
FROM "%sNameDB%"."OINV" T0
WHERE T0."DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND T0."DocSubType" != 'ND' AND 1=2;
ELSEIF ( :Object = '13' AND :Tipo = 'Impuestos') THEN --------------------------- Consulta Impuestos IVA --------------------------------------- SELECT CASE WHEN T1."DocCur" IN ('COP', '$') then REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL((SUM(T0."TaxSum")),19,2),',','.') ELSE REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL((SUM((T0."BaseSumSys"*T1."DocRate")*T0."TaxRate"/100)),19,2),',','.') END AS "Valor",
'01' AS "Tipo", 'IVA' AS "Nombre", '0.00' AS "Redondeo",
CASE WHEN T1."DocCur" IN ('COP', '$') then REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL((SUM(T0."BaseSum")),19,2),',','.') ELSE REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL((SUM(T0."BaseSumSys"*T1."DocRate")),19,2),',','.') END AS "ValorBase",
REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL((T0."TaxRate"),19,2),',','.') AS "Porcentaje"
FROM "%sNameDB%"."INV4" T0 LEFT JOIN "%sNameDB%"."OINV" T1 ON T0."DocEntry"=T1."DocEntry" WHERE T0."DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND T1."DocSubType" != 'DN' AND T0."RelateType" = 1 GROUP BY T0."TaxRate", T1."DocCur";
ELSEIF ( :Object = '13' AND :Tipo = 'Retenciones') THEN --------------------------- Consulta Impuestos RETEIVA --------------------------------------------------- SELECT REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL((SUM(T0."WTAmnt")),19,2),',','.') AS "Valor", '05' AS "Tipo", 'RETEIVA' AS "Nombre", '0' AS "Redondeo", REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL((select sum(a."LineTotal") from "%sNameDB%".INV1 a where a."DocEntry" = :DocEntry),19,2),',','.') AS "ValorBase", REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL((SUM(T1."PrctBsAmnt")),19,2),',','.') AS "Porcentaje", 'WSD' AS "CodigoUnidadMedidaBase"
FROM "%sNameDB%"."INV5" T0 INNER JOIN "%sNameDB%"."OWHT" T1 ON T0."WTCode"=T1."WTCode" LEFT JOIN "%sNameDB%"."OINV" T2 ON T0."AbsEntry"=T2."DocEntry" WHERE T0."AbsEntry" = :DocEntry AND T1."U_HBT_TipRet" = '20' AND T2."DocSubType" != 'ND'--ICA GROUP BY T1."PrctBsAmnt", T1."U_HBT_TipRet"
--------------------------- Consulta Impuestos Retefuente --------------------------------------------------- UNION ALL SELECT CASE WHEN T2."DocCur" IN ('COP','IN') THEN REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL((SUM(T0."WTAmnt")),19,2),',','.') ELSE REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL((SUM( (T0."U_HBT_BaseRet"*T2."DocRate")*T1."PrctBsAmnt"/100 )),19,2),',','.') END AS "Valor", '06' AS "Tipo", 'RETEFUENTE' AS "Nombre", '0' AS "Redondeo",

/*Cuando el descuento es cero y tiene muestra comercial*/ SELECT '00' AS "codigo", 'Descuento por IVA - Muestra comercial' AS "descripcion", '0' AS "indicador", SUM(T1."VatSum") AS "monto", (SELECT TOP 1 SUM(A."BaseSum") FROM "%sNameDB%"."INV4" A WHERE A."DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND A."RelateType" = 1 ) AS "montoBase", TO_DECIMAL( ( ( SUM(T1."VatSum") * 100) / (SELECT TOP 1 SUM(A."BaseSum") FROM "%sNameDB%"."INV4" A WHERE A."DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND A."RelateType" = 1 ) ),19,2) AS "porcentaje", '1' AS "secuencia"

WHEN (SELECT CASE B."Decimals" WHEN '-1' THEN (SELECT TOP 1 "QueryDec" FROM "%sNameDB%"."OADM") ELSE B."Decimals" END FROM "%sNameDB%"."OINV" A LEFT JOIN "%sNameDB%"."OCRN" B ON A."DocCur"=B."CurrCode" WHERE A."DocEntry" = :DocEntry)= '1' THEN REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL((T0."RoundDif"),19,1),',','.') WHEN (SELECT CASE B."Decimals" WHEN '-1' THEN (SELECT TOP 1 "QueryDec" FROM "%sNameDB%"."OADM") ELSE B."Decimals" END FROM "%sNameDB%"."OINV" A LEFT JOIN "%sNameDB%"."OCRN" B ON A."DocCur"=B."CurrCode" WHERE A."DocEntry" = :DocEntry)= '2' THEN REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL((T0."RoundDif"),19,2),',','.') WHEN (SELECT CASE B."Decimals" WHEN '-1' THEN (SELECT TOP 1 "QueryDec" FROM "%sNameDB%"."OADM") ELSE B."Decimals" END FROM "%sNameDB%"."OINV" A LEFT JOIN "%sNameDB%"."OCRN" B ON A."DocCur"=B."CurrCode" WHERE A."DocEntry" = :DocEntry)= '3' THEN REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL((T0."RoundDif"),19,3),',','.') WHEN (SELECT CASE B."Decimals" WHEN '-1' THEN (SELECT TOP 1 "QueryDec" FROM "%sNameDB%"."OADM") ELSE B."Decimals" END FROM "%sNameDB%"."OINV" A LEFT JOIN "%sNameDB%"."OCRN" B ON A."DocCur"=B."CurrCode" WHERE A."DocEntry" = :DocEntry)= '4' THEN REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL((T0."RoundDif"),19,4),',','.') WHEN (SELECT CASE B."Decimals" WHEN '-1' THEN (SELECT TOP 1 "QueryDec" FROM "%sNameDB%"."OADM") ELSE B."Decimals" END FROM "%sNameDB%"."OINV" A LEFT JOIN "%sNameDB%"."OCRN" B ON A."DocCur"=B."CurrCode" WHERE A."DocEntry" = :DocEntry)= '5' THEN REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL((T0."RoundDif"),19,5),',','.') WHEN (SELECT CASE B."Decimals" WHEN '-1' THEN (SELECT TOP 1 "QueryDec" FROM "%sNameDB%"."OADM") ELSE B."Decimals" END FROM "%sNameDB%"."OINV" A LEFT JOIN "%sNameDB%"."OCRN" B ON A."DocCur"=B."CurrCode" WHERE A."DocEntry" = :DocEntry)= '6' THEN REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL((T0."RoundDif"),19,6),',','.') ELSE '0' END AS "RedondeoAplicado",

/*Cuando el descuento es cero y tiene muestra comercial*/ SELECT '00' AS "codigo", 'Descuento por IVA - Muestra comercial' AS "descripcion", '0' AS "indicador", SUM(T1."VatSum") AS "monto", (SELECT TOP 1 SUM(A."BaseSum") FROM "%sNameDB%"."INV4" A WHERE A."DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND A."RelateType" = 1 ) AS "montoBase", TO_DECIMAL( ( ( SUM(T1."VatSum") * 100) / (SELECT TOP 1 SUM(A."BaseSum") FROM "%sNameDB%"."INV4" A WHERE A."DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND A."RelateType" = 1 ) ),19,2) AS "porcentaje", '1' AS "secuencia"

ELSEIF ( (SELECT TOP 1 T0."DiscSum" FROM "%sNameDB%"."OINV" T0 WHERE "DocEntry" = :DocEntry) = 0 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "%sNameDB%"."INV1" T1 WHERE "DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND T1."U_BO_TPR" = 'MC' ) = 0 ) THEN /*Cuando el descuento es cero y no tiene muestra comercial*/ SELECT REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL((0),19,2),',','.') FROM DUMMY WHERE 1=2;
ELSEIF ( (SELECT TOP 1 T0."DiscSum" FROM "%sNameDB%"."OINV" T0 WHERE "DocEntry" = :DocEntry) = 0 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "%sNameDB%"."INV1" T1 WHERE "DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND T1."U_BO_TPR" = 'MC' ) > 0 ) THEN
/*Cuando el descuento es cero y tiene muestra comercial*/ SELECT '00' AS "codigo", 'Descuento por IVA - Muestra comercial' AS "descripcion", '0' AS "indicador", SUM(T1."VatSum") AS "monto", (SELECT TOP 1 SUM(A."BaseSum") FROM "%sNameDB%"."INV4" A WHERE A."DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND A."RelateType" = 1 ) AS "montoBase", TO_DECIMAL( ( ( SUM(T1."VatSum") * 100) / (SELECT TOP 1 SUM(A."BaseSum") FROM "%sNameDB%"."INV4" A WHERE A."DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND A."RelateType" = 1 ) ),19,2) AS "porcentaje", '1' AS "secuencia"
FROM "%sNameDB%"."INV1" T1 WHERE "DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND T1."U_BO_TPR" = 'MC';
ELSEIF ( (SELECT TOP 1 T0."DiscSum" FROM "OINV" T0 WHERE "DocEntry" = :DocEntry) = 0 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "INV1" T1 WHERE "DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND T1."U_BO_TPR" = 'MC' ) > 0 ) THEN
/*Cuando el descuento es mayor a cero y no tiene muestra comercial*/ SELECT '01' AS "codigo", 'Descuento comercial' AS "descripcion", '0' AS "indicador", T1."DiscSum" AS "monto", (SELECT TOP 1 SUM(A."BaseSum") FROM "%sNameDB%"."INV4" A WHERE A."DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND A."RelateType" = 1 ) AS "montoBase", ((T1."DiscPrcnt")) AS "porcentaje", '1' AS "secuencia"
FROM "%sNameDB%"."OINV" T1 WHERE "DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND T1."DiscSum" > 0;
ELSEIF ( (SELECT TOP 1 T0."DiscSum" FROM "%sNameDB%"."OINV" T0 WHERE "DocEntry" = :DocEntry) = 0 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "%sNameDB%"."INV1" T1 WHERE "DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND T1."U_BO_TPR" = 'MC' ) > 0 ) THEN
/*Cuando el descuento es mayor a cero y tiene muestra comercial*/ SELECT '01' AS "codigo", 'Descuento comercial' AS "descripcion", '0' AS "indicador", T1."DiscSum" AS "monto", (SELECT TOP 1 SUM(A."BaseSum") FROM "%sNameDB%"."INV4" A WHERE A."DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND A."RelateType" = 1 ) AS "montoBase", ((T1."DiscPrcnt")) AS "porcentaje", '1' AS "secuencia"
FROM "%sNameDB%"."OINV" T1 WHERE "DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND T1."DiscSum" > 0
UNION ALL
SELECT '00' AS "codigo", 'Descuento por IVA - Muestra comercial' AS "descripcion", '0' AS "indicador", SUM(T1."VatSum") AS "monto", (SELECT TOP 1 SUM(A."BaseSum") FROM "%sNameDB%"."INV4" A WHERE A."DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND A."RelateType" = 1 ) AS "montoBase", TO_DECIMAL( ( ( SUM(T1."VatSum") * 100) / (SELECT TOP 1 SUM(A."BaseSum") FROM "%sNameDB%"."INV4" A WHERE A."DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND A."RelateType" = 1 ) ),19,2) AS "porcentaje", '1' AS "secuencia"
FROM "%sNameDB%"."INV1" T1 WHERE "DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND T1."U_BO_TPR" = 'MC';

WHEN (SELECT CASE B."Decimals" WHEN '-1' THEN (SELECT TOP 1 "QueryDec" FROM "%sNameDB%"."OADM") ELSE B."Decimals" END FROM "%sNameDB%"."OINV" A LEFT JOIN "%sNameDB%"."OCRN" B ON A."DocCur"=B."CurrCode" WHERE A."DocEntry" = :DocEntry)= '4' THEN REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL((T0."RoundDif"),19,4),',','.') WHEN (SELECT CASE B."Decimals" WHEN '-1' THEN (SELECT TOP 1 "QueryDec" FROM "%sNameDB%"."OADM") ELSE B."Decimals" END FROM "%sNameDB%"."OINV" A LEFT JOIN "%sNameDB%"."OCRN" B ON A."DocCur"=B."CurrCode" WHERE A."DocEntry" = :DocEntry)= '5' THEN REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL((T0."RoundDif"),19,5),',','.') WHEN (SELECT CASE B."Decimals" WHEN '-1' THEN (SELECT TOP 1 "QueryDec" FROM "%sNameDB%"."OADM") ELSE B."Decimals" END FROM "%sNameDB%"."OINV" A LEFT JOIN "%sNameDB%"."OCRN" B ON A."DocCur"=B."CurrCode" WHERE A."DocEntry" = :DocEntry)= '6' THEN REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL((T0."RoundDif"),19,6),',','.') WHEN T0."DiscPrcnt" != '0' AND T0."DocCur" IN ('COP','$') THEN REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL(((SELECT TOP 1 SUM(A."BaseSum") FROM "%sNameDB%"."INV4" A WHERE A."DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND A."RelateType" = 1 )),19,2),',','.') WHEN T0."DiscPrcnt" != '0' AND T0."DocCur" IN ('COP','$') THEN REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL(((SELECT TOP 1 SUM(A."BaseSum") FROM "%sNameDB%"."INV4" A WHERE A."DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND A."RelateType" = 1 )+T0."DiscSum"),19,2),',','.') WHEN T0."DiscPrcnt" != '0' AND T0."DocCur" NOT IN ('COP','$') THEN REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL(((SELECT TOP 1 SUM(A."BaseSumSys"*B."DocRate") FROM "%sNameDB%"."INV4" A INNER JOIN OINV B ON A."DocEntry"=B."DocEntry" WHERE A."DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND A."RelateType" = 1 )+T0."DiscSum"),19,2),',','.') /*Cuando el descuento es cero y tiene muestra comercial*/ SELECT '00' AS "codigo", 'Descuento por IVA - Muestra comercial' AS "descripcion", '0' AS "indicador", SUM(T1."VatSum") AS "monto", (SELECT TOP 1 SUM(A."BaseSum") FROM "%sNameDB%"."INV4" A WHERE A."DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND A."RelateType" = 1 ) AS "montoBase", TO_DECIMAL( ( ( SUM(T1."VatSum") * 100) / (SELECT TOP 1 SUM(A."BaseSum") FROM "%sNameDB%"."INV4" A WHERE A."DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND A."RelateType" = 1 ) ),19,2) AS "porcentaje", '1' AS "secuencia"

WHERE T0."AbsEntry" = :DocEntry AND T1."U_HBT_TipRet" = '10' AND T2."DocSubType" != 'ND'
GROUP BY T1."U_HBT_TipRet" --, T1."PrctBsAmnt"

FROM "%sNameDB%"."INV5" T0 INNER JOIN "%sNameDB%"."OWHT" T1 ON T0."WTCode"=T1."WTCode" LEFT JOIN "%sNameDB%"."OPCH" T2 ON T0."AbsEntry"=T2."DocEntry" WHERE T0."AbsEntry" = :DocEntry AND T1."U_HBT_TipRet" = '20' AND T2."DocSubType" != 'ND' GROUP BY T1."PrctBsAmnt", T1."U_HBT_TipRet"

/*Cuando el descuento es negativo y no tiene muestra comercial*/ SELECT REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL((0),19,2),',','.') FROM DUMMY WHERE 1=2;
ELSEIF ( (SELECT TOP 1 T0."DiscSum" FROM "%sNameDB%"."OPCH" T0 WHERE "DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND T0."DocSubType" = 'DN') < 0 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "%sNameDB%"."PCH1" T1 WHERE "DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND T1."U_BO_TPR" = 'MC' ) > 0 ) THEN
/*Cuando el descuento es negativo y tiene muestra comercial*/ SELECT '00' AS "codigo", SUM(T1."VatSum") AS "monto" FROM "%sNameDB%"."PCH1" T1 WHERE "DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND T1."U_BO_TPR" = 'MC';
ELSEIF ( (SELECT TOP 1 T0."DiscSum" FROM "%sNameDB%"."OPCH" T0 WHERE "DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND T0."DocSubType" = 'DN') = 0 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "%sNameDB%"."PCH1" T1 WHERE "DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND T1."U_BO_TPR" = 'MC' ) = 0 ) THEN /*Cuando el descuento es cero y no tiene muestra comercial*/ SELECT REPLACE(TO_DECIMAL((0),19,2),',','.') FROM DUMMY WHERE 1=2;
ELSEIF ( (SELECT TOP 1 T0."DiscSum" FROM "%sNameDB%"."OPCH" T0 WHERE "DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND T0."DocSubType" = 'DN') = 0 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "%sNameDB%"."PCH1" T1 WHERE "DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND T1."U_BO_TPR" = 'MC' ) > 0 ) THEN
/*Cuando el descuento es cero y tiene muestra comercial*/ SELECT '00' AS "codigo", 'Descuento por IVA - Muestra comercial' AS "descripcion", '0' AS "indicador", SUM(T1."VatSum") AS "monto", (SELECT TOP 1 SUM(A."BaseSum") FROM "%sNameDB%"."INV4" A WHERE A."DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND A."RelateType" = 1 ) AS "montoBase", TO_DECIMAL( ( ( SUM(T1."VatSum") * 100) / (SELECT TOP 1 SUM(A."BaseSum") FROM "%sNameDB%"."INV4" A WHERE A."DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND A."RelateType" = 1 ) ),19,2) AS "porcentaje", '1' AS "secuencia"
FROM "%sNameDB%"."PCH1" T1 WHERE "DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND T1."U_BO_TPR" = 'MC';
ELSEIF ( (SELECT TOP 1 T0."DiscSum" FROM "OPCH" T0 WHERE "DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND T0."DocSubType" = 'DN') = 0 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "PCH1" T1 WHERE "DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND T1."U_BO_TPR" = 'MC' ) > 0 ) THEN
/*Cuando el descuento es mayor a cero y no tiene muestra comercial*/ SELECT '01' AS "codigo", 'Descuento comercial' AS "descripcion", '0' AS "indicador", T1."DiscSum" AS "monto", (SELECT TOP 1 SUM(A."BaseSum") FROM "%sNameDB%"."INV4" A WHERE A."DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND A."RelateType" = 1 ) AS "montoBase", ((T1."DiscPrcnt")) AS "porcentaje", '1' AS "secuencia"
FROM "%sNameDB%"."OPCH" T1 WHERE "DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND T1."DiscSum" > 0;
ELSEIF ( (SELECT TOP 1 T0."DiscSum" FROM "%sNameDB%"."OPCH" T0 WHERE "DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND T0."DocSubType" = 'DN') = 0 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "%sNameDB%"."PCH1" T1 WHERE "DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND T1."U_BO_TPR" = 'MC' ) > 0 ) THEN
/*Cuando el descuento es mayor a cero y tiene muestra comercial*/ SELECT '01' AS "codigo", 'Descuento comercial' AS "descripcion", '0' AS "indicador", T1."DiscSum" AS "monto", (SELECT TOP 1 SUM(A."BaseSum") FROM "%sNameDB%"."INV4" A WHERE A."DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND A."RelateType" = 1 ) AS "montoBase", ((T1."DiscPrcnt")) AS "porcentaje", '1' AS "secuencia"
FROM "%sNameDB%"."OPCH" T1 WHERE "DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND T1."DiscSum" > 0
UNION ALL
SELECT '00' AS "codigo", 'Descuento por IVA - Muestra comercial' AS "descripcion", '0' AS "indicador", SUM(T1."VatSum") AS "monto", (SELECT TOP 1 SUM(A."BaseSum") FROM "%sNameDB%"."INV4" A WHERE A."DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND A."RelateType" = 1 ) AS "montoBase", TO_DECIMAL( ( ( SUM(T1."VatSum") * 100) / (SELECT TOP 1 SUM(A."BaseSum") FROM "%sNameDB%"."INV4" A WHERE A."DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND A."RelateType" = 1 ) ),19,2) AS "porcentaje", '1' AS "secuencia"
FROM "%sNameDB%"."PCH1" T1 WHERE "DocEntry" = :DocEntry AND T1."U_BO_TPR" = 'MC';
